h: Man sees his new face for the first time, 24 hours after his own child gave him a facelift
p: A viral video shows a father looking at his new face for the first time, just a day after a facelift performed by his own child. Before and after images show his face still swollen and taped, with surgical dressings still in place shortly after the operation. Viewers have been amazed that he barely recognised himself.
more: Swelling is normal so soon after surgery, so the final result could look quite different once he heals.
The healing process for a facelift usually takes weeks to settle.
Many viewers praised the child for trusting their skills on their own parent.
alt: Before surgery, bandaged after the operation, and 24 hours after: an older man's face during facelift recovery
